Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! The players are making their way out in the middle now. Ishan Kishan and Shubman Gill are the two openers for India​. Dilshan Madushanka to start with the new ball. Here we go...
... THE RUN CHASE ...

Right then, Sri Lanka have posted a massive total on the board. They will be confident enough to defend this, but will be wary of the quality of the Indian batters. It is going to be a really exciting chase to watch. Let's see how it unfolds.

India looked a bit out of sorts in the first four overs of the Powerplay and gave away a bit too many runs. Their spinners pulled the game back for them and then Chahal removed the dangerous Mendis and Umran followed it up with the wicket of Bhanunka in the next over. Then it was Axar who built pressure on the batters by restricting the run flow and picking up a couple of crucial wickets in the middle overs. After that, Umran showed his raw pace to get two wickets in two balls which put Lanka more on the back foot. At one stage, they had picked 3 wickets in 20 balls but their poor show at the death allowed Sri Lanka off the hook and they ran away with a total above 200.

Earlier, Sri Lanka got off to the perfect start where both the openers showed intent and played their shots without fear. They were also helped by the Indian bowlers who were overstepping for fun and giving away extras. Kusal Mendis got to his fifty in no time but got out soon after that. The openers added 80 runs and the foundation was set. However, they lost their way in the middle overs, but a quick-fire knock from Charith Asalanka and the fireworks in the death overs from their skipper, Dasun Shanaka got them to a huge score.

Dasun Shanaka, take a bow! What an electrifying knock from this underrated batter! He hammered a quickfire fifty - the fastest for Sri Lanka and helped his team amass 77 runs in the last 5 overs. Hardik Pandya pats him on the back! India have a mountain to climb if they want to secure the series here in Pune.

SIX! Off the outside edge but Sri Lanka will take it! A length ball is angled in around middle, Dasun Shanaka tries to heave but it takes the outer half and flies all the way over third man for a biggie. 20 from the over, Sri Lanka end on 206 for 6.
Swing and a miss! In the channel outside off, on a shorter length, Shanaka flashes at it and misses.

DROPPED AND SIX! Fifty for Dasun Shanaka off just 20 balls. Back of a length again, around off, Shanaka hammers it over mid off. Deepak Hooda jumps near the fence but to no avail as he parries it over to the fence.
Slower one, on a good length around off, Chamika Karunaratne tries to heave but only manages to drag it down to long on. A single.
Short and on off, Dasun pulls it to deep mid-wicket and runs the first run hard. That's all he will get.
SIX! Out of here! Back of a length, around off at 115 kph, Dasun Shanaka sits on the back foot and launches it over deep square leg for a biggie.
Shivam Mavi to bowl the last over. Can he keep Sri Lanka under 200?

Superb running between the wickets! Fuller and on off, Chamika Karunaratne walks forward and forces it down to long off. The fielder in the deep is a bit slow in taking off and they pinch the second run. 18 from the penultimate over, can Sri Lanka touch 200?
Yorker on off, Chamika digs it out back to the bowler. No siren this time as the crowd waits with bated breath.
Yorker on off, at 133.7 kph, Dasun digs it out to backward point for a single. It's another no ball, could you believe it? Free Hit again...
SIX! This one is dismissed! It's been a nightmare for Arshdeep Singh. His attempted yorker goes wrong and Dasun Shanaka dismisses this full toss over deep mid-wicket for a maximum.

Caught off a no ball! A low full toss on middle, at 135 kph, Dasun lifts it over mid on and Suryakumar Yadav catches it nicely near the fence. The Indian fans start to celebrate but then the siren goes off. Yet another no ball this evening. Free Hit coming up...
Fuller and around off, from 'round the wicket, Dasun steps down and slices it over cover-point for a single.
Seven runs from the first three balls. Can Arshdeep Singh finish well?

FOUR! Well executed! Arshdeep Singh returns from over the wicket and bowls a full toss around off at 136 kph, Dasun Shanaka shuffles across the stumps and scoops it behind short fine leg for a boundary.
Angles in a length ball on middle, at 113.1 kph, Karunaratne knocks it down to long on for a run.
Will we see a change in bowling? Yes, Arshdeep Singh to bowl the penultimate over. He conceded 19 runs in his first over.
Fuller and on off, at 147.8 kph, Chamika drives it to point and crosses. Expensive but effective outing for Umran Malik yet again.
Just a single off the Free Hit. A 148.3 kph full delivery, outside off, Shanaka drives it to extra cover for a run.

SIX! Dasun Shanaka is fighting fire with fire! Full in length and outside off, at 141 clicks, Dasun thwacks it over covers. Yuzvendra Chahal tries to catch it near the fence but it brushes his fingers and goes over the fence. It's a no ball also. Free Hit coming up...
Around off, on a good length at 144.1 kph, Chamika tries to drive but gets an inside edge. It rolls in front of short mid-wicket and they pinch a single.
Very full and around leg at 147.9 kph, Dasun steps back and drags it off the inner half to deep square leg. Only a run.

SIX! The quicker you bowl, the faster you travel. Umran Malik digs it in short, around middle and leg to follow the batter, Shanaka tries to pull but it flies off the top edge and clears fine leg with ease.
FOUR! The hat-trick ball goes for a boundary to silence the crowd. Fuller in length and around off, at 151.4 kph, Dasun Shanaka clobbers it over mid off and gets a boundary. 150 comes up!
Fuller in length, around off and angling in at 134.6 kph, Chamika presses forward and defends it to the left side of the bowler.
Uses the angle of the bowler and works a length ball behind square leg for a single.
Slower again, on a length around off at 117.5 kph, Chamika Karunaratne taps it down to cover-point and crosses for a run.
Wide! Attempts the slower one, on a length but down leg at 121 kph, Chamika tries to flick but misses.
Wide for height! Looks like a slower bouncer, around middle, Chamika Karunaratne ducks.
Spears in a very full ball around off, at 138.5 kph, Chamika shuffles across the stumps and digs it out back to the bowler.
FOUR! Cracking shot! Fuller in length and around off, Chamika Karunaratne gets forward with a straight bat and thumps it past the bowler for a boundary at long off.
Short in length and outside off, Dasun pulls it over mid-wicket for a single.
Chamika Karunaratne comes out to the middle now. Also, Shivam Mavi (2-0-24-0) comes back into the attack.

OUT! OFF STUMP GOES FOR A WALK! The crowd roars and Umran Malik is pumped up. A sharp length delivery, on off at 140.4 kph and skidding off the surface after landing, Wanindu Hasaranga sits inside the crease like a dead duck. He attempts to defend it but plays down the wrong line. The ball scoots through and obliterates the off pole. What a sight!

OUT! CAUGHT! This time it has gone straight to Shubman Gill. Umran Malik speeds in and darts in a length ball around middle and leg at 142.8 kph, Charith Asalanka stays leg-side to this delivery and tries to heave it over mid-wicket. He doesn't time it well and is caught near the boundary line. A big breakthrough for the home team as Charith was looking dangerous.
Commentary.Howout: c Shubman Gill b Umran Malik

Commentary.Commentary: Wanindu Hasaranga joins his skipper at the crease now.
Wide called for height! Umran Malik bangs in a short ball on middle, Asalanka steps back and then leaves it alone.
Sharp delivery, a touch short and on middle at 145.9 kph, angling down, Dasun tries to flick but misses. It deflects off his pads to point and they cross.
A 148 kph delivery, full and on middle, it's worked behind square leg for a run.

SIX! Up and just over the fielder near the fence! Back of a length, around off at 138 clicks, Charith Asalanka rides the bounce and powers it over mid-wicket. Shubman Gill jumps near the fence but ends up tipping it behind. A good attempt!
Play and a miss! Short and around off, at 137.9 kph, Charith Asalanka feels for it and gets beaten.
Change in bowling. Umran Malik is back on!
Flighted, full and on middle, Dasun Shanaka works it towards mid-wicket. 16 runs off Chahal's last over, spoiling his figures somewhat.
Another low full toss, on leg, Dasun Shanaka clips it wide of deep mid-wicket where Shubman Gill covers his ground to the left and puts in a dive to keep it inside. Two runs taken!
Short and outside off, Charith Asalanka punches it towards sweeper cover for a single.
SIX! Two in a row! Yuzvendra Chahal shortens his length and bowls it around middle, Charith Asalanka gets into position quickly and pulls it over the deep mid-wicket fence for a biggie.

SIX! BANG! Charith Asalanka goes big now! This is tossed up, full and on middle, Charith Asalanka goes down and absolutely nails his slog-sweep to send the ball way over the deep mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
A low full toss, on off, Dasun Shanaka whips it wide of long on for just a run.

NOT OUT! Short in length and wide outside off, Charith Asalanka slaps it to deep point and attempts for the second run. The throw comes to the keeper who whips the bails off in a flash as Asalanka dives in. The third umpire watches the replays and finds that Asalanka has just survived here, by a millimetre.
Shout for a run out and it has been referred upstairs. It's touch and go and Charith Asalanka survives by a millimetre.
Full and wide outside off, Shanka drives it to point where the fielder dives to his right and parries it to sweeper cover for a single.
Dasun Shanaka is in next with his team falling off the radar.

OUT! TAKEN! Axar Patel with a double blow in no time! Dhananjaya de Silva fails again and throws his wicket away. Axar Patel sees the batter advance down the track and angles this into the batter, on leg, Dhananjaya de Silva still goes through his shot, but loses his grip as he connects with the ball. As a result, the ball goes up without any timing towards long on where Deepak Hooda settles under it to take a nice catch. Sri Lanka are four down now.
Commentary.Howout: c Deepak Hooda b Axar Patel

Commentary.Commentary: Another short delivery, on middle, Charith Asalanka flicks it off the back foot towards deep square leg for one.
Angles this one in, short and on leg, Dhananjaya de Silva works it towards mid-wicket for a run.
Short and outside off, Charith Asalanka cuts it towards sweeper cover for a single.
Fullish delivery, on middle, Dhananjaya de Silva pushes it back towards the bowler.
Shivam Mavi bowls another slower delivery, on a length and on leg, Charith Asalanka nudges it towards short fine leg for one.
Fuller one and on off, Dhananjaya de Silva drills it towards sweeper cover for a run.
A slower one now, on a length and on middle, Charith Asalanka tucks it to the leg side and gets across for a single.
SIX! Out of here! A length ball around off, Charith Asalanka flexes his muscles and dismisses it over wide long on for a biggie. 100 up!
Lands it on a length around off, Charith Asalanka defends it from the back foot to short cover.
Shivam Mavi comes back into the attack.
Quicker one, full and on leg, angling in, Dhananjaya de Silva pushes it towards covers.
Shortish and on middle, Charith Asalanka clips it towards square leg for a run.
Floated, full and on off, Dhananjaya de Silva drives it towards long off for a single.
Who will walk in next? Dhananjaya de Silva or Dasun Shanaka? It's the former.

OUT! TAKEN! Axar Patel strikes now! Pathum Nissanka tries to go big, but holes out this time. Axar Patel bowls this short again and on middle, Pathum Nissanka backs away a bit and goes for the heave, but he fails to get the right connection and hits it flat and in the air towards wide long on. Rahul Tripathi there runs to his left and takes a terrific catch to mark his debut. The umpires want to check if the catch is clean or not (the soft signal is out), and the replays confirm that it is a fair catch. Three wickets on the last 20 deliveries and it's a resounding comeback from the Men in Blue.
Commentary.Howout: c Rahul Tripathi b Axar Patel

Commentary.Commentary: Dropped again! This is short again and outside off, Charith Asalanka looks to steer it to thrid man but gets a thin edge as Ishan Kishan behind the stumps, fails to grab it. The ball rolls towards short fine leg. They cross.
Short and on middle, pulled over mid-wicket for a single.
A single as this full delivery is tucked through mid-wicket.

Dropped! A tough chance though! This is flighted, full and on middle, Pathum Nissanka smashes it uppishly towards the bowler where Yuzvendra Chahal goes down and stretches his right hand, but the ball does not stick in.
Shorter in length and on middle, Charith Asalanka nudges it towards square leg for one more.
Flatter and around off, Pathum Nissanka uses his feet and knocks it gently down towards long on for one.
A bit short and on middle, Charith Asalanka moves back and flicks it towards mid-wicket for a run.
Tossed up, full and on middle, Pathum Nissanka goes for the slog-sweep, but gets an inside edge through square leg for a single.
Shortish and around off, Nissanka steps back to make room but mistimes his shot at cover-point. They cross. At the halfway mark, Sri Lanka are 89 for 2.
Angles in a length ball around off, at 146.8 kph, Nissanka has his bat down in time as he defends it to the off side.
FOUR! A vital boundary for Nissanka's confidence. Back of a length, around off at 148.3 kph, Pathum Nissanka hangs back and bludgeons it down the ground for a boundary at long off. Stand and deliver!
Shortish and on off, at 137.1 kph, Pathum Nissanka plays it down to backward point.
Misfield! Full and outside off, at 141.5 kph, Charith Asalanka slices his attempted drive towards point. The fielder fumbles and they cross for a run.

Drinks! India have made a good comeback in the game by picking up two wickets in quick succession. Pathum Nissanka now needs to bat deep as he is the set batter here, while India will look to get a few more wickets and test the middle order of Sri Lanka again. Also, Charith Asalanka is the new batter.

OUT! STUMPS SHATTERED! A 146.8 kph delivery, short and around off from 'round the wicket. The angle takes it close to the batter who tries to use the pace and run it down to third man. All Bhanuka Rajapaksa manages is an inside edge and the stumps behind are disturbed. A good period of play for India as they are making a comeback. The move to promote Bhanuka flops for Sri Lanka.
Quicker and flatter, on middle, Bhanuka Rajapaksa quietly helps it towards square leg for one. End of a successful over from Chahal.
Uses his feet and this time works it through mid-wicket for a single.
Perhaps the googly, landing around off, Pathum walks forward and tries to flick but misses.
Floated and full, around leg, Bhanuka Rajapaksa gives the charge and flicks it in front of square on the leg side. It goes in the deep and they cross.
Bhanuka Rajapaksa has been promoted up the order.

OUT! LBW! Chahal removes the danger man. Flatter delivery, landing full around middle and straightening a bit, Mendis strides forward to defend but misses and is pinged on the pads. It looks a lot straighter this time but the finger stays down after the appeal. Hardik Pandya goes for the review. The UltraEdge finds no bat and the Ball Tracking shows three reds. India have a breakthrough now as Mendis falls after a breezy knock.
Stifled appeal for an lbw! A slider around leg, Mendis tries to flick but misses. It's missing the leg stump, perhaps.
Change of ends for Yuzvendra Chahal. He conceded six runs in his first over.
Very full and around leg, at 140.4 kph, Mendis flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a run. Another good over for Sri Lanka.
Lands it on a length and around off, Pathum pushes it away off the inner half and the ball rolls to mid on. They cross for a brisk run as the fielder misses his shy at the bowler's end.

FOUR! Runs continue to leak. Fuller in length and outside off, 145.1 kph, Pathum Nissanka hammers it through covers and despite the in-ring fielder getting his hand to it, the ball races away to the fence.
Clocks 138.7 kph and digs in a short ball on middle, Mendis plays a mistimed pull shot over mid-wicket for a single.
SIX! Fifty for Kusal Mendis, off just 27 balls. Short and outside off, 138 clicks, Mendis camps back and smacks it all the way over third man for a biggie.
Play and a miss! Back of a length and outside off, Mendis leans back and tries to ramp it towards third man but misses.
Let's see Umran Malik's pace today. It was 'just' 141 kph on the previous delivery...
Fires it full and on off, Pathum drives it back to the bowler. 12 from the over!
Fullish and on middle, it's wristed through mid-wicket for a single.
SIX! Right in the slot and it's dismissed! Flatter delivery, full and close to off, Kusal Mendis goes down on one knee and smokes it over deep mid-wicket.
Skidding down from middle, Pathum Nissanka flicks off the inner half to square leg. They cross.
FOUR! Easy pickings for Nissanka! This is short again and around leg, Pathum Nissanka moves on his back foot quickly and pulls it to the right of the deep square leg fence for a boundary.
Slightly shorter and outside off, Pathum Nissanka cuts it hard but straight to point.
A couple of good overs from the Indian spinners to bring some sanity. Axar Patel to continue after the Powerplay...
A single to end the over as this full delivery is driven towards mid on. Sri Lanka are on 55 for none at the end of Powerplay!
Shortish and on middle, Kusal Mendis moves back and nudges it to the right of the bowler for one more.
Floated and around middle, Pathum Nissanka uses his feet and drills it wide of mid on for another run.
Flatter, full and on middle, Kusal Mendis eases it towards long on for one.
Tossed up, full and on middle, Pathum Nissanka goes down and sweeps it through square leg for a run.
Yuzvendra Chahal starts with quicker delivery, short and on middle, Kusal Mendis cuts it very late towards short third man for a single. 50 up for Sri Lanka!
Yuzvendra Chahal to bowl the final over of the Powerplay.
Another dot to end the over! This is darted full and on the pads, Pathum Nissanka tucks it towards mid-wicket. A tidy over from Axar.
Angles this one into the batter, on leg, Pathum Nissanka gets hurried and fails to get any bat on it.
Slower through the air, on middle, Kusal Mendis works it to the right of the bowler for a single.
Fires in a full delivery, on off, Kusal Mendis digs it out towards mid on.
Flatter and shorter on off, Kusal goes back and punches it towards mid on.
Quicker delivery, full and on middle, Pathum Nissanka nudges it behind square leg and picks up a single.
Axar Patel comes into the attack now.
FOUR! Fine shot! This is pitched up, on off, Kusal Mendis stays there and times his drive perfectly, wide of mid off, for a boundary. 15 from the over and Sri Lanka have raced to 47 in no time.

Good fielding in the deep! A slower one, full and on off, Kusal Mendis goes through his slog a bit early and mistimes it high in the air over the bowler's head. Rahul Tripathi, from mid on, chases it and puts in a dive to keep it inside. Two runs taken!
On a length and on off, Kusal Mendis taps it to the off side.
Shivam Mavi gets away with this one! He bowls a full toss, on middle, Kusal Mendis only manages to loft it down the ground for two runs as the mid on fielder chases it down.

NO BALL AND FOUR! The Indian bowlers are giving away extras for free here. Shivam Mavi continues with his fuller length and serves it on middle, Kusal Mendis clears his front leg and thrashes it over the bowler's head for a boundary. Free Hit coming up again...
This is pitched up, on off, Pathum Nissanka works it with the inner half towards wide of mid on for a run.
Shivam Mavi begins with a full delivery, on off, Kusal Mendis swings across the line, but gets a top edge towards third man for a single.
Shivam Mavi replaces Arshdeep Singh from this end.

Back of a length and on off, shaping away, Pathum Nissanka gets squared up and ends up guiding it with the outer half towards point. 11 from the over, Sri Lanka have got the momentum in the Powerplay!
Another full delivery, on middle, Pathum Nissanka skips down the track and lofts it over extra cover and comes back for the second run.
This is full and around off, shaping away, Pathum Nissanka knocks it back towards the bowler.
On a length around middle, it's worked in front of square leg for a single.
SIX! It flies off the edge and clears the fence! Short in length and around off, Mendis tries to heave it across the line but the top edge takes the ball flying over third man for a maximum.
Short of a length and on off, Kusal Mendis swats it just over the mid-on fielder for a couple of runs.

Finally a legal delivery now! This is on a good length and on middle, Kusal Mendis swings across the line and gets a top edge as the ball flies up in the air behind the stumps. Ishan Kishan takes the catch, but it's a Free Hit and the batters complete a run.

NO BALL AND SIX! Arshdeep Singh is struggling with his front foot here. The third consecutive overstepping and this has been sent out of the ground. He serves this full and down the leg, Kusal Mendis stays there and uses his wrists to flick it over the deep square leg fence again for a maximum. Free Hit stays...
Waiting...waiting...no siren this time and the second over is finally over. Hardik Pandya to continue from the other end.

NO BALL AND FOUR! Kusal Mendis uses the Free Hit to his advantage! This is almost on a yorker length and on the pads, Kusal Mendis whips it away towards the deep square leg fence for a boundary. The siren goes up, a bigger no ball this time. Another Free Hit...

Arshdeep Singh loses his line a bit and bowls this on a good length down the leg side, Kusal Mendis misses his flick. The umpire signals a wide at first, but the third umpire confirms that it is a front foot no ball. Free Hit coming up...
Swing and a miss! This is on a hard length and outside off, Kusal Mendis goes for a big heave across the line but fails to connect.

Sharp bouncer! Arshdeep Singh bangs this short and outside off, Pathum Nissanka gets hurried and miscues his pull shot. It flies behind backward point and falls in front of the incoming third-man fielder.
Arshdeep Singh pulls his length back a bit and bowls this around off, angling away, Pathum Nissanka dabs it towards point.
Full again and on off, but swinging away from the batter this time, Pathum Nissanka drives it towards covers.
FOUR! Pathum Nissanka greets Arshdeep Singh with a boundary! Arshdeep Singh begins with a full delivery, on middle, swinging in, Pathum Nissanka flicks it through mid-wicket for four runs.
Who will bowl from the other end? It's going to be Arshdeep Singh, and not Shivam Mavi.
Once again beats the edge! Close to off, on a good length and nipping away, Kusal shows no surety there and ends up pushing and missing inside the line. Top over from Hardik!
Beauty from Pandya! Hurls across a beautiful outswinger, at 132.1 kph, in the channel outside off, Mendis has a tame poke inside the line and misses.
Pitches it up and around off, at 133 kph, Mendis drives square of the wicket on the off side but finds the fielder inside the ring.
Edgy! Pandya delivers an outswinger, on a length and outside off, Pathum Nissanka pushes inside the line and edges it down to third man for a single. He opens his account.
Wide! Hardik fails to control his line as he bends his back. His short ball flies down the leg side and it has been wided. Sri Lanka are away!
A touch short this time, around off, Pathum tries to play from the back foot but gets a bit of a bottom edge. It drops near the stumps and rolls back in front of the keeper.
Hardik starts well! Serves it very full and on off, a hint of away swing there, Pathum Nissanka pushes it back towards the bowler.

We are all set for the play to begin! The Indian players are out in the middle taking their respective field positions. Pathum Nissanka and Kusal Mendis are the two openers for Sri Lanka. Hardik Pandya to start proceedings with the ball. Let's play.

Dasun Shanaka, the captain of Sri Lanka, says they would have batted first anyway. Adds that it is important for the top order to click and hopes that they will do well in this game. Informs they are unchanged.

Hardik Pandya, the Indian captain, says that they want to bowl first as dew could be a factor. Feels that the pitch won't change much. Mentions that in this format, you need to be aware that rather than taking it deep, you have to finish it before. Praises his bowlers for their performance in the last game and informs that there is one forced change in Sanju Samson who has a bruised knee and Rahul Tripathi replaces him. Also, Hardik adds that Arshdeep Singh is fit and comes in for Harshal Patel.

Sri Lanka (Unchanged Playing XI) - Pathum Nissanka, Kusal Mendis (WK), Dhananjaya de Silva, Charith Asalanka, Bhanuka Rajapaksa, Dasun Shanaka (C), Wanindu Hasaranga, Chamika Karunaratne, Maheesh Theekshana, Kasun Rajitha, Dilshan Madushanka.

India (Playing XI) - Ishan Kishan (WK), Shubman Gill, Suryakumar Yadav, Rahul Tripathi (In for Sanju Samson), Hardik Pandya (C), Deepak Hooda, Axar Patel, Shivam Mavi, Arshdeep Singh (In for Harshal Patel), Umran Malik, Yuzvendra Chahal.
Toss - The coin goes up in the air and lands in favour of Hardik Pandya. INDIA ELECT TO BOWL FIRST!
Breaking - Big moment for Rahul Tripathi as he receives his first India cap from the Indian batting coach.

Pitch report - The square boundaries are shorter than a 72-meter hit down the ground. The pitch is hard in nature and offers good assistance to the seamers. There is a nice breeze blowing across the stadium and the dew factor will be negligible. The team batting first has won 75 per cent of the games and it won't be a surprise if the team winning the toss opts to bat first.

Sri Lanka, on the other hand, would be disappointed that they lost the previous game, but they showed a lot of character. However, their top order was at fault once again, and they look like a team that is way too dependent on Wanindu Hasaranga and Maheesh Theekshana to provide them with breakthroughs. Their batting will need to improve a lot if they want to get anything from this game. Will they be able to fight back and level the series? Or will India take an unassailable 2-0 lead? We will find out soon. Toss and team news in a bit.

India emerged victorious by just two runs in the first T20I thanks to their lethal bowling attack. Shivam Mavi was the star with the ball, while Deepak Hooda showed his firepower with the bat. However, they will hope that others also step up and give a good account of themselves. Another big story in the Indian camp is that Sanju Samson has been ruled out of this series, and Jitesh Sharma is his replacement. So, it will be interesting to see whether he or Mukesh Kumar gets a game here.

Hello and a warm welcome to our coverage of the 2nd T20I between India and Sri Lanka. This match will be played at the Maharashtra Cricket Association Stadium in Pune. India got over the line in the first game, but it was not as comfortable as they would have wanted. They will look to put on a better performance and seal the series, while Sri Lanka will fight hard to come on level terms. If the first game is anything to go by, we can expect another exciting clash.
... MATCH DAY ...
